text_block_list.text: ――Your Santa has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Sis...!? 
Weren't you out on a journey――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, was it a surprise? Total success, 
Meno. 
Though I have to say, I was surprised that 
you were the very first one to contact me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Meno was the one who invited you? 
Now that's a double surprise...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to drop by anyway, if I 
made it in time. 
That's precisely why I 'had high hopes' 
for how the party would turn out, but...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Coming here as an invited guest 
is so much better. 
――Well then, Meno, shall we begin as 
promised?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! For our final event, we will be 
handing out Christmas presents! 
Please accept a gift from us Santas, one 
for each of you!

text_block_list.name: Stego & Meno
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas, sir! Merry Christmas, 
sir! 
Here ya go, Merry Xmas. Had fun? Glad to 
hear it, Merry Xmas~.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... thank you so much! 
Eeeek, SteGo-senpai is super rare~! I'm so 
happy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Kuh... Hahahahaha! Hahaha! 
To think you would drag that one out—you 
really went all out!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Somehow Mame-chin pulled off the ultimate 
'exceeding expectations'~. 
At least for us, it hit like a 
swordfish-class strike.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, man... we got completely one-upped. 
Heh heh—she really is a sparkplug in her 
own way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo, Journey. Taking a breather?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
……Yes. Thank you for your hard work as 
Santa. 
I was completely convinced you were still 
traveling abroad.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What was with the photo you sent last 
night? Saying, 'I'm in Hong Kong right 
now'... 
It was a picture I'd never seen before, so 
I fell for it completely.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
From the private collection. Fakes like 
that are essential for a good surprise, 
right? 
——It was Meno's strategy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ————…………F-Fufufu…… Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, truly…… a surprise that exceeded all 
expectations. 
Just what I'd expect from Meno-san. 
Hitting us from an angle we'd never 
anticipate.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Sis? Did the party turn out 
as you expected…… 
or rather, even better than you hoped?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Everyone has a big smile and is 
having the time of their lives. 
Letting you all handle it was definitely 
the right call.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……How about you, Journey? Did you enjoy 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I am very satisfied. 
Above all, seeing those kids——

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Gathering together like this and looking 
so happy. 
——I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah———— That's good. It was well worth 
egging them on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (System Monologue)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho, heave-ho, heave-ho——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Let's wrap up the feast with a three-clap 
cheer~~~~♪" 
————AS IF WE'D LET IT END THERE, 
ORAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The final stage starts here! 
Or rather, the real party time begins 
right now!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What are you doing at this hour?! 
It's already late, so it's about time to 
wrap things up, sir!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! There's one more 
souvenir, you know. 
Glad this made it in time too. Alright 
Golshi, let's go. Ready, heave!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Stego
text_block_list.text:
Behold: the "Reindeer Spring Festival 
Float! ~Garnished with Marimo Trees~".

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: …………Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And so!! Time to charge into the 
afterparty~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? An afterparty—I haven't heard 
anything about this, Golshi-san!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, just listen up. This baby is my 
prized masterpiece, ya know? 
Secretly developed over two hundred 
million grueling years!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The reindeer wobbles on springs! Then 
heave-ho on a festival float! 
Plus, the seat comes equipped with an 
electric rotating system!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And Golshi just kept insisting she wanted 
to add a cute little tree to it, 
so I made one out of Lake Akan marimo 
merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand what you're talking 
about at all!?!? 
What on earth is this bizarre 
contraption?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Meno. 
You worked super hard this time, so I'll 
give you the honor of the first ride.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, hop on, hop on, Mame-chin! 
There we go, hoist her up, lift, lift!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, we're gonna rock it with 
all we've got. 
Have fun, Meno.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hm. What is this? A remote control?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the remote for the electric 
rotation system. 
If you press this switch here~.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, how bizarre. 
Then let us crank the rotation to the 
absolute limi————hm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W　o　aaaa　　　　　a 
a 
　　　　　　　　　　　a　　　　aa　aaaa　a

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she's flying, she's flying. 
Alright, all clear, Mame-chin cat——ch, 
GUAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. What a disaster. Well, I kind of saw 
that coming.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ahhahahaha!! Nice catch, Golshi!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahaha, haaaahahahaha!! 
A magnificent ride, that was truly beyond 
expectations, Meno!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Giggle…… Yes, truly. 
————Quite literally, 'exceeding 
expectations.'

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
~~~~~~~nnnnnngh!! 
In the end, this is always how it turns 
out with these people……!!!!
